purpose: Slow or mid-tempo songs whose emotional arc matters more than constant novelty.

rules.opening: establish world and recurring subjects; hold longer than feels fashionable
rules.verse: narrative or intimate detail; alternate wides and closeups
rules.pre_chorus: tighten framing or introduce a recurring motif
rules.chorus: return to one iconic visual idea with greater scale or intensity
rules.instrumental: leave literal storytelling and permit abstraction, travel, stock texture, or procedural motion
rules.bridge: reduce visual density; one vulnerable image or sparse typography
rules.final_chorus: resolve earlier motifs and increase light, scale, or motion
rules.outro: one memorable closing image; permit a long hold
